problem: The single-context bridge planner remained anchored to the unsupported draft answer: its only valid case selected Sir Peter Lampl, while two verbose three-hypothesis responses hit the 256-token boundary. Meanwhile, post-hoc bridge terms made the fixed retriever hit gold in all three cases, establishing repeated independent-hypothesis omission rather than an absolute retrieval failure.
simplest_baseline: B2 is the rejected single-context planner that sees the question, audited draft, unsupported exact answer, and failed query before proposing three bridge hypotheses.
hypothesis: A single dynamically triggered, draft-blind Counter-Hypothesis context that sees only the original question and unresolved obligation, and returns a compact BridgePacket without rationale prose, will reduce answer anchoring and retrieve gold evidence on at least two of the three saved cases without increasing search calls.
anti_claim: This is a frozen-model context-isolation and budget-routing experiment, not training and not a model-capability improvement.

relevant_mechanisms: sub-agents only when delegation has net benefit
framework_comparisons.current_gap: The proposed worker adopts DeerFlow's isolation boundary but is narrower: it is spawned only by typed answer-level debt, cannot search, and returns one compact packet to the shared ledger.
Its legacy comparison warns against role-count expansion. This loop adds only one isolated hypothesis packet after a measured anchoring failure, not a standing supervisor hierarchy.
B3 would resemble fixed execution agents and spend more queries. B4 instead isolates only counter-hypothesis generation and leaves retrieval and synthesis centralized.

MindSearch executes multiple branches. B4 must first show that context isolation can discover the missing bridge while Lead still spends one registered search, avoiding duplicated zero-recall branches.

frozen_controls: one Counter-Hypothesis provider attempt per open debt
no Writer or Judge during retrieval calibration
multi_agent_comparison_contract: B2 = current single-context Evidence-Debt planner; B3 = fixed three parallel Researchers, recorded but not implemented; B4 = one Evidence-Debt-triggered draft-blind Counter-Hypothesis packet. Lock DeepSeek model, retriever, corpus, one query call, planner token cap, total Token and USD accounting. B4 must beat B2 gold-hit cases on saved calibration before any end-to-end or unseen-slice run.
next_action: Do not integrate B4. Open a bounded candidate-generation versus candidate-selection diagnostic: require answer-linked latent anchors, preserve all candidates, and test them without letting the same generation call self-select the only search.
claim_boundary: This is the first loop where multi-agent context isolation is eligible, based on repeated saved failures. B3 remains planned, B4 remains unproven, and no effectiveness claim is permitted before a passed calibration and unseen paired comparison.
